scope: Seven bounded current read/data families, including all five finite content kind tags; not a complete Bridge UI/source audit.

rows.acquisition: Installed File subscription emits accepted source, acquires shared construction, prepares optional Git status and enumerates initial tree. Product row encoding maps the current native tree row and chunks by encoded-byte/member bounds.
rows.currentness: Subscription/product-source/admission and construction lifetime are distinct from a displayed row. This pass did not retrace every incremental/deferred file update.
rows.readEffect: Opening source metadata installs context and acquires construction custody; not a pure durable-row query.
rows.persistence: Current live source/manifest/projection data; not proof that file bytes or row catalog are retained in SQL.

rows.acquisition: Current IPC controller projects paneState.diff.packageMetadata/status/error, native selection and item summaries; validates response budget.
rows.currentness: Current native publication/package/generation/selection, not source file bytes, DOM or new Git capture.
rows.readEffect: This inspected projection reads current state; surrounding mounted-controller admission remains required.
rows.persistence: Live native product projection; no retained exported table is established by this DTO.

rows.acquisition: Descriptor must match an issued manifest read plan under matching product/source admission. Factory opens a validated contained regular file; streaming closes the reader on completion/cancellation/error and checks observed byte count/hash before terminal end.
rows.currentness: Issued source/descriptor, current work admission and actual file bytes; opening/descriptor acceptance is separate from complete content. Current validation requires declaredByteLength == maximumBytes == window.maximumBytes; this is not a general arbitrary-range file API.
rows.readEffect: Runtime issued-descriptor/read-plan lookup and content lease/reader lifecycle; no file write selected.
rows.persistence: Finite filesystem content; does not become replicated SQL by being transferred.

rows.acquisition: Acquire matching content authority lease; load observed range from current loader cache; compare handle and any declared range/hash/whole-length witnesses; settle content lease. Provider sends qualified buffered range with end-of-source disposition.
rows.currentness: Package/item/handle/source/generation and range identity; metadata-only getContent does not supply these bytes or prove rendered application.
rows.readEffect: Content authority leases and loader/cache lifecycle; not durable effect execution.
rows.persistence: Current backing content/ranges behind retained product authority; actual storage lifetime is source-specific, not generic SQL replication.

rows.acquisition: Prior same-HEAD query walk supplies SQL/source analysis and query reservation. The freshly inspected claim consumes a matching descriptor/authority reservation and permits continuation for a nonfinal page; producer streams the reserved page and emits terminal byte-count/hash facts.
rows.currentness: Query snapshot, source/publication generation, worker/session/derivation and page lifetime; descriptor alone is not current rendered comments.
rows.readEffect: Query/page reservation and one-use claim; no automatic output effect.
rows.persistence: SQL workflow/source-derived finite projection; runtime reservations are not retained workflow rows.

rows.acquisition: Descriptor and body each inspect the immutable SQL attempt. Body consumes a matching issued descriptor, rereads the attempt, reconstructs/compares descriptor and returns exact prepared bytes/hash; producer transfers buffered content.
rows.currentness: Attempt identity and immutable bytes/metadata, separately from destination effect and SQL finalization outcome.
rows.readEffect: Bounded issued-descriptor registration/one-use removal; inspecting/transferring bytes does not execute clipboard/file output.
rows.persistence: Exact attempt bytes are current workflow SQL state; export/history selection still belongs to the target contract.

rows.acquisition: Current authorized query reservation is claimed once; producer captures comparison targets through real reviewSourceProvider with capture/cutoff/max-row inputs, encodes bounded catalog and transfers it with qualified delivery disposition.
rows.currentness: Request/reservation and current target/source observations with explicit truncation; catalog is not an atomic immutable refs snapshot or native selection application.
rows.readEffect: Consumes runtime reservation and performs real source acquisition; no Git mutation selected by this catalog read.
rows.persistence: Finite generated catalog, not proof of a retained target table.

proofLimit: Declarations and deciding production functions read. Prior projection SQL/source query trace explicitly reused at same HEAD. No runtime, whole UI, render, service extraction, schema/interop, effect or performance proof. No future ownership or export choice is selected.
fieldListLimit: Meaningful current Swift stored fields; encoders add literal tags/keys and nested shapes. Not an exhaustive replacement wire schema.
